elements.element: Cap is mutual (applies to each Party)
elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed"

elements.element: Cap amount is the greater of the fee limb and USD 1,000,000
elements.evidence: "the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000"

elements.element: Fee limb is fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim"
"neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect or consequential damages"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out: breach of confidentiality obligations
elements.evidence: "Except for Excluded Claims"; "a Party's breach of its confidentiality... obligations"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out: infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "The Company's (Customer's) payment obligations for all amounts due under this Agreement are not \"damages\" for purposes of this Section 10.9"

elements.element: Fallback: mutual cap of 12 months' fees (exact basis)
elements.evidence: cap is "the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000", not a cap equal to 12 months' fees

elements.element: Fallback: carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct"

reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are present in the inserted Section 10.9: mutual greater-of cap with the exact fee basis and claim anchor, USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual indirect/consequential exclusion, and the full uncapped carve-out set (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other party's IP).

The Customer payment-obligations carve-out is expressly stated in operative text ('payment obligations for all amounts due under this Agreement are not "damages"'), so the deterministic flag on that item is not borne out by the rendered language; the '(Customer's)' gloss merely identifies the Company as our party and does not create a dangling mechanic.

Fallback is not literally satisfied because the cap is a greater-of construct rather than a cap equal to 12 months' fees, but the locked target is preferred and preferred is complete, so the levels are not mixed.

Insertion is minimal and appropriate: the Agreement contained no liability cap at all, and the new subsection is a concise stand-alone clause that leaves headings/counterparts and all other terms untouched.
